svg.title: Cycles versus block width at height 16, VLEN=1024
svg.desc: Four log-scale panels showing that scalar C cycles grow with block width while RVV cycles stay almost flat.
svg.text: Cycles vs block width (height fixed at 16)
VLEN=1024 · log scale · C grows ~6–13× for paeth/cfl_pred/blend, RVV barely moves — cost is per row, not per pixel
C at W=4 is an outlier († in the report), so its ratio is misleading.
